f3.why: a model of the hypotheses proposed from the statement: the release's own 40-tuple, cast to the integers. The generated proof discharges each hypothesis by `first | decide | simp | norm_num`, which cannot prove admissibility for every prime; the tactic below proves it from the claimant's own lemma admissibleTuple_admissible (hence withClaim). It is the proof the 2026-11-10 run certified.
f3.tactic:
intro h
  refine h (_root_.PrimeGap186.admissibleTuple.map ⟨((↑) : ℕ → ℤ), Nat.cast_injective⟩)
    (by rw [Finset.card_map]; exact _root_.PrimeGap186.admissibleTuple_card) ?_
  intro p hp
  haveI : NeZero p := ⟨hp.ne_zero⟩
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hnot⟩ := _root_.PrimeGap186.admissibleTuple_admissible p hp
  refine ⟨(a : ZMod p), ?_⟩
  intro z hz heq
  obtain ⟨n, hn, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp hz
  apply hnot
  refine Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨n, hn, ?_⟩
  have h2 : (n : ZMod p) = (a : ZMod p) := by simpa using heq
  have h3 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff' n a p).mp h2
  rwa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (Finset.mem_range.mp ha)] at h3
